'''A-13''' was a landing pad that was located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Pinett]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a group of protesters from the [[Pinett Freedom Force]] occupied the pad and attempted to prevent [[Starship/Legends|starships]] from landing there. However, the group inadvertently activated a [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] in the bay, which pulled a [[Jon-Tow Economic Development Group]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] out of [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of Pinett and sent the vessel hurtling towards the moon.
